# BidBench (Bidding Wizards)

> Free contractor bid estimator. Paste a job in plain words or drop a PDF blueprint and get an itemized bid: materials, labor, contingency, markup, GST, and the profit and margin the contractor keeps. No sign-in, no API key, no card. Markets: New Zealand, Australia, United States.

BidBench is a single-page app (hash routing: `/#/bid`). Bid math is plain arithmetic: direct = materials + labor; contingency = direct x contingency%; bid = (direct + contingency) x (1 + markup%); margin = profit / bid. AI is used only to read blueprint PDFs and classify documents; it never invents quantities.

## Product

- [Landing page](https://bidding-wizards.vercel.app/): what it does and who it is for
- [Estimator](https://bidding-wizards.vercel.app/bid): the bid tool
- [NZ sample bid](https://bidding-wizards.vercel.app/bid?loc=nz&sample=1): NZ re-roof, metres, GST 15%
- [AU sample bid](https://bidding-wizards.vercel.app/bid?loc=au&sample=1): composite deck, GST 10%
- [US sample bid](https://bidding-wizards.vercel.app/bid?loc=us&sample=1): bath remodel, square feet
- [Pitch deck](https://bidding-wizards.vercel.app/pitch.html): traction and team
